title: Base Entity Schema
description: The foundational schema inherited by all technology entities within the Forge AI Engineering Intelligence Platform.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Core identity and categorization details for the entity.

id.title: Entity ID
id.description: Unique identifier for the entity following the pattern <category>-<technology>-<variant>.

name.title: Entity Name
name.description: The primary display name of the entity.

canonical_name.title: Canonical Name
canonical_name.description: The standardized, formal name of the entity.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Alternative names or abbreviations for the entity.

category.title: Category
category.description: The top-level category of the technology.

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: More specific classification within the main category.

description.title: Description
description.description: A comprehensive description of the entity and its purpose.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: Details regarding the creators, licensing, and lifecycle status.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: The organization, community, or individual responsible for developing the entity.

license.title: License
license.description: The license under which the entity is distributed.

open_source.title: Open Source
open_source.description: Indicates whether the entity is open source.

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: The date when the entity was officially released.

latest_version.title: Latest Version
latest_version.description: The most recent version or release identifier.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current lifecycle status of the project or technology.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: A set of relevant keywords describing features or paradigms.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: The primary industries or domains where this entity excels.

use_cases.title: Use Cases
use_cases.description: Specific scenarios or problems this entity solves.

maturity.title: Maturity
maturity.description: The readiness level for real-world application.

specifications.title: Specifications
specifications.description: Detailed technical specifications. This section is intentionally generic; specialized schemas should extend this object with technology-specific properties.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: A list of notable features and capabilities.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: Connections, integrations, and operational context within the broader ecosystem.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Entity IDs of natively supported integrations.

compatible_with.title: Compatible With
compatible_with.description: Entity IDs of compatible technologies or standards.

deployment_targets.title: Deployment Targets
deployment_targets.description: Entity IDs of supported deployment environments or platforms.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Entity IDs of managed service providers offering this technology.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Entity IDs of core dependencies required for operation.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: Guidelines and rules for when to recommend this entity.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: System-level tracking data for this record.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Explicit definitions of how this entity relates to others in the knowledge base.
